checker.transport: direct codex exec with -c model_provider=openai (ChatGPT backend), read-only sandbox
checker.provenance_conflict: the receipt's own checker_lane field reads 'VERIFY_SECURITY via HGK lane dispatcher; provider openai-codex'; the round record says direct codex exec. Both strings are preserved; neither is asserted as true because the raw transcript is not in this workspace.
checker.transport_why: the HGK dispatcher routes through model_provider=desktop_router (127.0.0.1:10102), which served gpt-6.1-sol as opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash on round 3 -- the maker's own model family, so round 3 was discarded as non-independent (REPORT F-17)
checker.identity_source: codex-rollout (model=gpt-6.1-sol, model_provider=openai verified from the session rollout)

checks.detail: 27-to-27 bijection; no duplicate atom IDs, trace IDs or target IDs.
All endpoints bind the current PI and corresponding atom identities.
All required fields are nonempty. Fixture existence and oracle execution were not tested.
Computed from the single ECP effect_class field. Declared distribution agrees. This does not ratify the candidate vocabulary.

Expressible by schema: permission is unconstrained and effect_class accepts USER_DATA_EFFECT. The current issuer is a placeholder, so concrete authenticated USER_DATA_EFFECT authorization is not demonstrated.
Retrying with a stable operation identity is logically compatible with deduplicated at-most-once effects. Runtime enforcement and retry-window coverage are not proven.
Scopes agree. Prefix-qualified reading passes 3/3. Bare equality fails 3/3 and is a mis-stated exam under the supplied convention, not an artifact defect.
All eight claims carry bind-time verification evidence. Readiness is consistent with those records. This inspects recorded evidence rather than repeating repository runtime probes.
Both retain derivation records. Explain identities reference earlier derivation stages rather than final resealed identities. Replay was not independently reproduced.
No byte change was observed between initial hashing, analysis snapshot and final hashing. Preliminary reads preceded initial hash capture; changes before that capture cannot be excluded.

Current PI/ECP body hashes detect explain/replay stripping when checked against their retained hashes. Body hashing excludes identity fields, trace and _profile_meta; independent byte hashes cover those and formatting. The unsigned provenance sidecar is not an authenticity anchor.

checker.sod_note: different model from the maker (gpt-6.1-sol vs deepseek-v4.1-flash), different credential (owner OAuth, read-only sandbox), maker could not write the receipt -- it was extracted from the lane's own stdout. Still ONE owner: this is a design-record pass, not DOC-05 INDEPENDENT_VERIFIED and not runtime acceptance.
checker.receipt_extraction: apply_checker_receipt.py / inline brace-scan; the checker ran read-only and could not write its own receipt
